verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document deployment environments, approval gates on deployments, or tracking which change is deployed to which environment. The only related items are generic claims about customizable deployment workflows, Kubernetes cluster deployment, pipeline compliance controls, and human-in-the-loop approvals for AI agent sessions. None of these covers this story's capability, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can define deployment environments with approval gates and track which change is deployed where
